test_name: SMS-002 template errors never abort a scan / a template with an unparseable date skips the message
evidence: test/logic/sms/sms_import_service_test.dart:374: expect(await scan(), 1); || Rule: 'parsed by the first enabled template ... whose sender filter and keywords match' and 'A template error (bad regex, unparseable date) skips the message'. In this test the bad-date template (lower id) matches sender and keyword, fails on the date, and the message is still imported by the next template (the preset): scan() returns 1. Same in 'a broken template is skipped and the others still import' (`expect(await scan(), 2);`). Behaviour: the erroring template is passed over and the next enabled template is tried; the message is not skipped. The rule's literal reading contradicts the assertion; reword to 'a template error makes that template pass over the message (the next enabled template is tried) and never aborts the scan'.
